ei.title: 1번 — 영국 주택 시장의 장기 금융 필요성
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: Houses in Britain are too expensive in relation to income for households to buy a house for ready money at the beginning of their housing career or accumulate the purchase money from prior savings. Most householders must therefore either hire a house, or buy one with borrowed money. Housing must therefore be financed, and the finance has to be for a long term. For buyers using borrowed funds, long-term loans are necessary to ensure that the principal repayments can be spread out thinly enough to be covered by annual income. The investor in rental properties often finds that the yearly rent only covers a small portion of the debt used to purchase the property.

questions.passage: Houses in Britain are too ①<u>expensive</u> in relation to income for households to buy a house for ready money at the beginning of their housing career or accumulate the purchase money from prior savings. Most householders must therefore ②<u>either</u> hire a house, or buy one with borrowed money. Housing must therefore ③<u>be financing</u>, and the finance has to be for a long term. For buyers using borrowed funds, long-term loans are ④<u>necessary</u> to ensure that the principal repayments can be spread out thinly enough to be covered by annual income. The investor in rental properties often finds that the yearly rent only covers a small portion of the debt used to purchase the property.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ be financing → be financed: Housing은 금융 지원을 '받는' 대상이므로 수동태(be financed)가 맞음. be financing(능동 진행)은 부적절 / ① expensive 형용사 정상 / ② either A or B 구문 정상 / ④ necessary 형용사 보어 정상
det.analysis:
❌ ① expensive: 'Houses in Britain are too expensive' — 형용사 보어 정상
❌ ② either: 'either hire a house, or buy one' — either A or B 상관접속사 정상
✅ ③ be financing(오류): 'Housing must therefore be financing' — Housing은 금융 지원의 대상. 수동태 be financed가 맞음. be financing(능동 진행형)은 주어-동사 관계 불일치 ← 정답
❌ ④ necessary: 'long-term loans are necessary' — 형용사 보어 정상
det.tip: Housing(주거) = 금융 지원을 '받는' 대상 → 수동태(be financed). 능동(be financing)은 불가.

questions.passage: Houses in Britain are ①<u>too</u> expensive in relation to income for households to buy a house for ready money at the beginning of their housing career or accumulate the purchase money from prior savings. Most householders must therefore either hire a house, or buy one with ②<u>borrowing</u> money. Housing must therefore be financed, and the finance has to be for a long term. For buyers using borrowed funds, long-term loans are necessary ③<u>to ensure</u> that the principal repayments can be spread out thinly enough to be covered by annual income. The investor in rental properties often finds that the yearly rent only covers a small portion of the debt ④<u>used</u> to purchase the property.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② borrowing → borrowed: money는 '빌려진' 것이므로 과거분사 borrowed가 맞음. borrowing(현재분사/능동)은 부적절 / ① too expensive 부사 정상 / ③ to ensure 목적 부정사 정상 / ④ used to purchase 과거분사 정상
det.analysis:
❌ ① too: 'too expensive in relation to income' — 부사 too + 형용사 정상
✅ ② borrowing(오류): 'buy one with borrowing money' — money는 빌려진 대상. 과거분사 borrowed가 맞음. borrowing(능동)은 의미 부적절 ← 정답
❌ ③ to ensure: 'necessary to ensure that' — to부정사 부사적 용법 정상
❌ ④ used: 'the debt used to purchase' — 과거분사(debt가 사용된) 정상
det.tip: borrowed money = 빌린 돈(수동). borrowing money = 돈을 빌리는 행위(능동). 여기선 수동 의미.

questions.passage: Houses in Britain are too expensive ①<u>in relation of</u> income for households to buy a house for ready money at the beginning of their housing career or accumulate the purchase money from prior savings. Most householders must ②<u>therefore</u> either hire a house, or buy one with borrowed money. Housing must therefore be financed, and the finance has to be for a long term. For buyers using borrowed funds, long-term loans are necessary to ensure that the principal repayments can be spread out ③<u>thinly</u> enough to be covered by annual income. The investor in rental properties ④<u>often</u> finds that the yearly rent only covers a small portion of the debt used to purchase the property.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① in relation of → in relation to: 'in relation to'는 '~와 관련하여'라는 고정 전치사구. of는 불가 / ② therefore 부사 정상 / ③ thinly 부사(spread out thinly) 정상 / ④ often 빈도부사 정상
det.analysis:
✅ ① in relation of(오류): 'too expensive in relation of income' — 고정 표현 in relation to(~와 관련하여). of는 잘못된 전치사 ← 정답
❌ ② therefore: 'must therefore either hire' — 부사 삽입 정상
❌ ③ thinly: 'spread out thinly enough' — 부사(얇게 펴지다) 정상
❌ ④ often: 'The investor often finds' — 빈도부사 정상
det.tip: in relation to = ~와 관련하여. 고정 전치사구. in relation of(×).

questions.passage: Houses in Britain are too expensive in relation to income for households ①<u>to buy</u> a house for ready money at the beginning of their housing career or accumulate the purchase money from prior savings. For buyers using borrowed funds, long-term loans are necessary to ensure that the principal repayments can be spread out thinly enough to ③<u>be covered</u> by annual income. The investor in rental properties often ④<u>find</u> that the yearly rent only covers a small portion of the debt used to purchase the property.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ find → finds: 주어 The investor(3인칭 단수)이므로 동사에 -s가 필요. find(원형)는 수 일치 오류 / ① to buy 부정사 정상 / ② financed 수동태 정상 / ③ be covered 수동태 정상
det.analysis:
❌ ① to buy: 'for households to buy a house' — to부정사 정상
❌ ② financed: 'Housing must therefore be financed' — 조동사+수동태 정상
❌ ③ be covered: 'to be covered by annual income' — 수동태 정상
✅ ④ find(오류): 'The investor in rental properties often find' — 주어 The investor는 3인칭 단수. finds가 맞음. find(원형)는 수 일치 오류 ← 정답
det.tip: The investor(단수 주어) → finds(3인칭 단수). 전치사구 in rental properties에 현혹 주의.

questions.passage: Houses in Britain are too ①<u>expensive</u> in relation to income for households to buy a house for ready money at the beginning of their housing career or accumulate the purchase money from prior savings. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ unnecessary → necessary: 장기 대출이 원금 상환을 분산시키기 위해 '필요하다(necessary)'는 것이 문맥. unnecessary(불필요한)는 반대 의미 / ① expensive → 집이 비싸다, 적절 / ② borrowed → 빌린 돈, 적절 / ④ small → 적은 부분, 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① expensive: 'Houses in Britain are too expensive' — 소득 대비 집이 비싸다. 적절
❌ ② borrowed: 'buy one with borrowed money' — 빌린 돈으로 구매. 적절
✅ ③ unnecessary(오류): 'long-term loans are unnecessary' — 원금 상환 분산을 위해 장기 대출이 '불필요'? 문맥상 necessary(필요한)가 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ④ small: 'only covers a small portion' — 연간 임대료가 적은 부분만 충당. 적절
det.tip: necessary = 필요한 ↔ unnecessary = 불필요한. 장기 대출은 상환 분산을 위해 필수.

questions.passage: Houses in Britain are too expensive in relation to income for households to buy a house for ready money at the beginning of their housing career or ①<u>distribute</u> the purchase money from prior savings. For buyers using borrowed funds, long-term loans are necessary to ensure that the principal repayments can be spread out thinly enough to be covered by annual income. The investor in rental properties often finds that the yearly rent only covers a small ④<u>portion</u> of the debt used to purchase the property.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① distribute → accumulate: 가구들이 사전 저축으로 구매 자금을 '축적(accumulate)'하는 것이 문맥. distribute(분배)는 반대 방향 / ② hire → 집을 빌리다, 적절 / ③ long → 장기 금융, 적절 / ④ portion → 일부분, 적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① distribute(오류): 'distribute the purchase money from prior savings' — 사전 저축으로 구매 자금을 분배? 문맥상 축적(accumulate)이 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ② hire: 'either hire a house' — 집을 임대하다. 적절
❌ ③ long: 'the finance has to be for a long term' — 장기 금융 필요. 적절
❌ ④ portion: 'a small portion of the debt' — 부채의 적은 부분. 적절
det.tip: accumulate = 축적하다 ↔ distribute = 분배하다. 구매 자금은 모으는(축적) 것.

det.analysis: 본문 S1: 'Houses in Britain are too expensive in relation to income' — 소득 대비 주택 가격이 너무 비쌈. True
det.tip: too expensive in relation to income = 소득 대비 너무 비싼.

questions.stem: 임대 부동산 투자자의 연간 임대료 수입은 부동산 구입에 사용된 부채의 대부분을 충당한다.

det.analysis: 본문 S5: 'the yearly rent only covers a small portion of the debt used to purchase the property' — a small portion(적은 부분)이지 대부분이 아님. False
det.tip: a small portion = 적은 부분 ≠ 대부분. only가 '~만'으로 한정.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ the principal repayments(원금 상환금) = 장기 대출로 분산시켜야 할 대상. 연간 소득으로 충당 가능할 만큼 얇게 펼쳐야 함
det.analysis:
① a house for ready money: S1의 표현이지만, 장기 대출로 분산시킬 대상이 아님
② the yearly rent from tenants: S5의 임대료 관련이지만 빈칸 문맥(spread out thinly)과 무관
③ the purchase money from prior savings: S1의 사전 저축 자금. 대출 상환 문맥과 무관
④ ← 정답: 'long-term loans are necessary to ensure that __________ can be spread out thinly enough to be covered by annual income' — 원금 상환(principal repayments)을 얇게 분산
det.tip: spread out thinly = 얇게 분산하다. 원금 상환액이 연간 소득으로 감당 가능하도록.

det.korean: ① are 삽입 오류: 원문 'too expensive in relation to income for households'에서 'in relation to income' 뒤에 are를 넣으면 이중 동사(are...are) 오류 / ② must therefore either 조동사+부사+상관접속사 정상 / ③ has to be 의무 표현 정상 / ④ to ensure 목적 부정사 정상
det.analysis:
✅ ① in relation to income are(오류): 'Houses in Britain are too expensive in relation to income are for households' — are가 삽입되어 이중 동사 구조. 원문은 'in relation to income for households' ← 정답
❌ ② must therefore either: 'Most householders must therefore either hire' — 조동사+부사+상관접속사 정상
❌ ③ has to be: 'the finance has to be for a long term' — 의무 표현(~해야 한다) 정상

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ 높은 주택 가격 → 장기 금융 의존 = 글의 요지. 현금/저축 불가 → 대출 필수 → 장기 필수

④ 단기 대출 유리 → S3에서 장기 금융 필수 명시. 불일치
